<thought>The previous search with both broken and formed functional groups returned no templates. I will broaden the search to only require breaking a “carboxylic esters” group, which should retrieve templates that include ester reductions such as the DIBAL‑H transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

    "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["carboxylic esters"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
